info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Optics Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of optics battery details within the catalog. It allows users to create new entries for battery specifications, ensuring accurate and up-to-date product information is available. Typical consumers of this API include product managers and inventory systems that require detailed and structured battery data. The efficient handling of optics battery details supports better product offerings and enhances overall catalog data integrity.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit details regarding optics batteries. It processes the provided information and stores it in the system, enabling efficient management and tracking.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send details about the optics battery operations. The information provided will be processed to manage and update the battery records accordingly.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

CreateCatalogOpticsBatteryDetailRequest.title: Optics Battery Order Request

optics_battery_id.description: The unique identifier for the optics battery being ordered.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person or organization requesting the order.

quantity.description: The quantity of optics batteries being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the order is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the optics battery.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the optics battery.

supplier.description: Information about the supplier providing the optics battery.

CreateCatalogOpticsBatteryDetailRequest.description: A request to order an optics battery with specific details including quantity, priority status, pricing, dimensions, and supplier information.

Dimensions.title: Dimensions

width.description: The width of the optics battery.

height.description: The height of the optics battery.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the dimensions (e.g., cm, in).

Dimensions.description: The dimensions of an optics battery, including width, height, and the unit of measurement.

Supplier.title: Supplier

verified.description: Indicates whether the supplier has been verified.

Supplier.description: Details about the supplier of the optics battery.

Contact.title: Contact

email.description: The email address of the supplier contact.

phone.description: The phone number of the supplier contact.

Contact.description: Contact details for the supplier, including email and phone number.

CreateCatalogOpticsBatteryDetailResponse.title: Battery Operation Response

status.description: The status of the battery operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the record created or updated by the operation.

processedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records matched during the operation.

pricing.description: Pricing details related to the operation.

CreateCatalogOpticsBatteryDetailResponse.description: Response schema for battery operation posting, containing information regarding the operation status, record, and pricing details.

PricingDetails.title: Pricing Details

net.description: The net amount of the pricing.

currency.description: The currency in which the pricing is expressed.

taxIncluded.description: Indicates whether the tax is included in the pricing.

PricingDetails.description: Details regarding the pricing for the operation, including net amount, currency, and tax information.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource returned in the response.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken, in milliseconds, to process the request.
